description: This file defines a Java interface 'CategoryRepository' which extends JpaRepository to interact with CategoryEntity objects in the database. It includes a custom method 'findByCategoryId' to retrieve categories by their categoryId.

classes.name: CategoryRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing CategoryEntity entities with standard CRUD operations and a custom finder method.

methods.name: findByCategoryId
methods.description: Custom query method to find a CategoryEntity by its categoryId.
